snippet.title: Catjinni Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Super excited to announce my new game Catjinni! It’s a single player survivor-like auto-shooter where you play as a catmage with a loyal catjinn sidekick. Use traps, customize your catmage, and unlock epic powers and equipment by completing quests! 

I expect it to release in Q2 2025. 

The hardest part for indie devs like me is getting the word out, so any reposts are hugely appreciated! 

Wishlist now on STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955630/Catjinni/

https://www.meta.com/de-de/experiences/catjinni/9319040004779451/
